title: manifest.yml
description: A project's manifest: the registries it installs from, the artifacts it wants, and the targets it projects into. Where this schema and the CLI disagree, the CLI is authoritative.

$schema.description: Ignored by the CLI; lets an editor find this schema.

name.description: This project's name. Shown in output; never resolved.

aireg.description: Oldest aireg CLI that can read this file. A plain SemVer, meaning this version or newer.

targets.description: Targets to install into, by name. Absent or empty means claude-code and codex.

harnesses.description: `targets` by the name aireg 0.1 reads, which aireg writes unless the manifest says `targets`.

registries.description: Where artifacts come from, keyed by the alias a reference uses.

^(.*)$.description: One address, and whatever the adapter reading it needs to know.

anyOf.description: Shorthand for an address with nothing else to say.

source.description: The address: a repository, a directory on this machine, or a registry URL.

adapter.description: Which adapter reads it. Omit to let the address decide.

ref.description: A tag, a branch, or a full commit id. What it means is the adapter's to say.

path.description: The folder inside the source that holds the registry, when it is not the root.

layout.description: How the source lays out what it holds, which aireg records the first time it reads one that is not a registry.

anyOf.description: A registry laid out as the file spec describes, with a `registry.json` at its root.

A plugin marketplace, `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` or else `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json`, or one plugin with its own manifest: `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` or an Agent Plugins `plugin.json`.
A site's Agent Skills discovery index, `/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json` in the 0.2.0 format, whose skills are `SKILL.md` files or `.tar.gz` and `.zip` archives.
Skills as folders holding a `SKILL.md`, up to three levels down, and agents as `*.md` files in `agents/` or `.claude/agents/`.

config.description: Adapter-defined scope selection, such as a workspace.

artifacts.description: A string reference, or `{ ref, as, exclude, targets, copy, trust }` to rename it, leave members out, narrow where it lands, copy it rather than link it, or trust a plugin it brings.

anyOf.description: An address, such as acme/platform or acme/platform/skill/lint@1.2.0.

ref.description: Any reference a string entry takes.

as.description: Unique local name used when remote artifacts collide. One artifact only.

exclude.description: Members a whole registry or namespace leaves out, relative to `ref`, such as `skill/lint`.

targets.description: Targets this entry projects into, narrowing the manifest's `targets:`.

harnesses.description: `targets` by the name aireg 0.1 reads, which aireg writes unless the manifest says `targets`.

copy.description: Copy into each target folder rather than linking, as `aireg add --copy` records.

trust.description: Plugins, by name, allowed to install with the hooks, servers or executables they carry, as `aireg add --trust` records.

exports.description: What this project makes for others to install: a path, such as an artifact or a folder of them, or a glob, or `{ path, kind, version, depends_on, publish, exclude, ignore, include }` to give one path a kind it must be, an exact version, dependencies, `publish: false` to keep it here, or the files it publishes.

items.description: One path, or one path and what to publish it with.

anyOf.description: A path relative to the project, or a glob over paths, such as .claude/skills/*.

path.description: One path relative to the project: an artifact, such as .claude/agents/reviewer.md, or a folder, whose artifacts directly inside it are each exported.

kind.description: When set, every artifact the entry reaches must be this kind.

version.description: The exact version to publish it at, such as 2.0.0.

depends_on.description: What it needs installed beside it.

items.description: An artifact in the project, or a folder of them, as ./ and its path, which is exported with it, or an artifact listed under `artifacts:`, as <registry>/<namespace>/<kind>/<name> with no version.

publish.description: `false` keeps it in this repository; absent, it goes to `publish.to`.

exclude.description: For a folder of artifacts: the names of what is directly inside it that it does not export.

ignore.description: Gitignore patterns, relative to each artifact the entry reaches: the files left out. The entry file always goes.

include.description: The only files each artifact the entry reaches publishes, besides its entry file, which always goes: a path, or `{ from, as }` to store one at another path.

anyOf.description: A file or folder relative to the artifact, stored at the same path.

from.description: A file or folder relative to the artifact.

as.description: The path it is stored at in the published version.

to.description: Where exports are published, as `aireg publish --to` takes it: a declared registry and a namespace, such as acme/engineering, or a registry folder and a namespace, such as ./registry/engineering.
